products.title: Scientific Graphic Function Calculator
products.description: The PURSONIC Scientific Graphic Function Calculator is a slim and portable tool designed for students and professionals. It features a 2.5-inch multi-line LCD screen for visualizing complex calculations and includes 20 built-in graphs for visual learning. This comprehensive calculator is suitable for a wide range of subjects, including algebra, geometry, trigonometry, calculus, statistics, biology, chemistry, physics, business, and finance. It also offers fraction calculation, a variety of utilities, probability functions, and an instant replay feature. The device supports three operating modes (Angular Measurement, Calculation, and Display) and comes with a durable protective cover for safe transport.

products.title: TI-30XS MultiView Scientific Calculator
products.description: The Texas Instruments TI-30XS MultiView is a scientific calculator designed for students in general math, Pre-Algebra, Algebra 1 and 2, Geometry, Statistics, general science, Biology, and Chemistry. It features a MultiView display that supports up to four lines, allowing users to view multiple calculations simultaneously and compare results. The calculator displays math expressions, symbols, and stacked fractions exactly as they appear in textbooks, eliminating the need for technical syntax. Additionally, it provides scientific notation output with proper superscripted exponents and an (x,y) table of values for function exploration.

products.title: Texas Instruments MultiView Scientific Calculator - 34MV/TBL/1L1/A
products.description: The Texas Instruments TI-34 MultiView is a scientific calculator designed to improve mathematical understanding for students in middle school math, pre-algebra, algebra 1 and 2, general science, and geometry. It features a 16-digit, four-line LCD display and MathPrint mode, which displays numbers and expressions as they appear in textbooks. The calculator includes a list conversion function for internalizing number formats and dedicated functions for integer division and step-by-step fraction simplification. It is powered by a dual power system consisting of a solar cell and one CR2032 battery.

products.title: Explorer Scientific Calculator
products.description: The Texas Instruments TI-15 Explorer is an elementary scientific calculator designed for students in grades 3 through 6. It features a transparent, impact-resistant blue case that allows students to see the internal components. The calculator includes color-coded keys for easy navigation and a two-line display providing clear viewing of entries and results. Key educational tools include step-by-step fraction reduction, conversion between fractions, decimals, and percents, and built-in flash cards for basic arithmetic practice. It is powered by a dual system utilizing both solar cells and battery power.

products.title: fx-115ES PLUS B 2nd Edition Advanced Scientific Calculator
products.description: The Casio fx-115ES PLUS B 2nd Edition is an advanced non-programmable, non-graphing scientific calculator featuring a Natural Textbook Display for easy reading of mathematical expressions. It offers 252 functions, including matrix and vector calculations, differential and integration capabilities, and a wide range of scientific constants and metric conversions. This model is powered by a single AAA battery with an approximate 3-year life and comes with a protective hard case.

products.title: Sharp EL501X2BWH Scientific Calculator
products.description: The Sharp EL501X2BWH (EL-501XBWH) is a scientific calculator designed for students studying general math, pre-algebra, algebra, geometry, and trigonometry. It features a 10-digit LCD screen and can perform over 130 scientific and math functions. For durability, it comes with a hard cover to protect the device from scratches and includes an auto power-down feature to conserve battery. This model is permitted for use on various standardized tests, including AP Chemistry, AP Physics, PSAT/NMSQT, SAT I, SAT II, Math IC, and Math IIC.
